@Public() decorator: bypasses TenantGuard + RolesGuard (critical for\n7\t *     Docker healthcheck which sends plain wget without auth headers)\n8\t *   - @SkipThrottle(): prevents rate-limiting of probe requests\n9\t *   - Consistent response format across all microservices\n10\t *   - Proper HTTP 503 when all checks fail (not just body status)\n11\t *\n12\t * Adds Redis and NATS connectivity as additional readiness checks\n13\t * beyond the standard database check.\n14\t *\n15\t * @see ADR-012 section 10 (Observability)\n16\t */\n17\timport { Controller, Inject, Logger, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\n18\timport { InjectDataSource } from '@nestjs/typeorm';\n19\timport { DataSource } from 'typeorm';\n20\timport { ClientProxy } from '@nestjs/microservices';\n21\timport { StandardHealthController } from '@aquaculture/backend-common/health';\n22\timport Redis from 'ioredis';\n23\timport { REDIS_CLIENT } from '../shared/redis.provider';\n24\t\n25\t@Controller('health')\n26\texport class HealthController extends StandardHealthController {\n27\t  private readonly healthLogger = new Logger('messaging-service:HealthController');\n28\t\n29\t  constructor(\n30\t    @InjectDataSource() dataSource: DataSource,\n31\t    @Optional()\n32\t    @Inject(REDIS_CLIENT)\n33\t    private readonly redis?: Redis,\n34\t    @Optional()\n35\t    @Inject('NATS_SERVICE')\n36\t    private readonly natsClient?: ClientProxy,\n37\t  ) {\n38\t    super(dataSource);\n39\t    this.serviceName = 'messaging-service';\n40\t  }\n41\t\n42\t  /**\n43\t   * Additional readiness checks for Redis and NATS connectivity.\n44\t   * These supplement the standard database check from StandardHealthController.\n45\t   *\n46\t   * Optional dependencies that are not injected (undefined) are silently\n47\t   * skipped rather than reported as errors. This avoids false 'degraded'\n48\t   * status when the provider is simply not in the current module scope.\n49\t   *\n50\t   * A failing Redis or NATS check results in 'degraded' status (HTTP 200),\n51\t   * not 'not_ready' (HTTP 503) -- only total failure of ALL checks triggers 503.\n52\t   */\n53\t  protected override async getAdditionalChecks(): Promise<Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'>> {\n54\t    const checks: Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'> = {};\n55\t\n56\t    // Redis connectivity check (only if Redis client is injected)\n57\t    if (this.redis) {\n58\t      try {\n59\t        await this.redis.ping();\n60\t        checks['redis'] = 'ok';\n61\t      } catch (error) {\n62\t        this.healthLogger.warn(\n63\t          `Redis health check failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n64\t        );\n65\t        checks['redis'] = 'error';\n66\t      }\n67\t    }\n68\t\n69\t    // NATS connectivity check (only if NATS client is injected)\n70\t    if (this.natsClient) {\n71\t      try {\n72\t        await this.natsClient.connect();\n73\t        checks['nats'] = 'ok';\n74\t      } catch (error) {\n75\t        this.healthLogger.warn(\n76\t          `NATS health check failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n77\t        );\n78\t        checks['nats'] = 'error';\n79\t      }\n80\t    }\n81\t\n82\t    return checks;\n83\t  }\n84\t}\n85\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b36211f9-9401-4f61-a4ad-9145984cd5dc","uuid":"9a821373-5bfa-4224-95e0-2bec6d41f614","timestamp":"2026-09-25T09:41:29.909Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-4527c3bf807e/apps/messaging-service/src/health/health.controller.ts","content":"/**\n * @module HealthController\n * @description Health check endpoints for liveness and readiness probes.\n *\n * Extends StandardHealthController to inherit:\n *   - @Public() decorator: bypasses TenantGuard + RolesGuard (critical for\n *     Docker healthcheck which sends plain wget without auth headers)\n *   - @SkipThrottle(): prevents rate-limiting of probe requests\n *   - Consistent response format across all microservices\n *   - Proper HTTP 503 when all checks fail (not just body status)\n *\n * Adds Redis and NATS connectivity as additional readiness checks\n * beyond the standard database check.\n *\n * @see ADR-012 section 10 (Observability)\n */\nimport { Controller, Inject, Logger, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { InjectDataSource } from '@nestjs/typeorm';\nimport { DataSource } from 'typeorm';\nimport { ClientProxy } from '@nestjs/microservices';\nimport { StandardHealthController } from '@aquaculture/backend-common/health';\nimport Redis from 'ioredis';\nimport { REDIS_CLIENT } from '../shared/redis.provider';\n\n@Controller('health')\nexport class HealthController extends StandardHealthController {\n  private readonly healthLogger = new Logger('messaging-service:HealthController');\n\n  constructor(\n    @InjectDataSource() dataSource: DataSource,\n    @Optional()\n    @Inject(REDIS_CLIENT)\n    private readonly redis?: Redis,\n    @Optional()\n    @Inject('NATS_SERVICE')\n    private readonly natsClient?: ClientProxy,\n  ) {\n    super(dataSource);\n    this.serviceName = 'messaging-service';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Additional readiness checks for Redis and NATS connectivity.\n   * These supplement the standard database check from StandardHealthController.\n   *\n   * Optional dependencies that are not injected (undefined) are silently\n   * skipped rather than reported as errors. This avoids false 'degraded'\n   * status when the provider is simply not in the current module scope.\n   *\n   * A failing Redis or NATS check results in 'degraded' status (HTTP 200),\n   * not 'not_ready' (HTTP 503) -- only total failure of ALL checks triggers 503.\n   */\n  protected override async getAdditionalChecks(): Promise<Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'>> {\n    const checks: Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'> = {};\n\n    // Redis connectivity check (only if Redis client is injected)\n    if (this.redis) {\n      try {\n        await this.redis.ping();\n        checks['redis'] = 'ok';\n      } catch (error) {\n        this.healthLogger.warn(\n          `Redis health check failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n        );\n        checks['redis'] = 'error';\n      }\n    }\n\n    // NATS connectivity check (only if NATS client is injected)\n    if (this.natsClient) {\n      try {\n        await this.natsClient.connect();\n        checks['nats'] = 'ok';\n      } catch (error) {\n        this.healthLogger.warn(\n          `NATS health check failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n        );\n        checks['nats'] = 'error';\n      }\n    }\n\n    return checks;\n  }\n}\n","numLines":85,"startLine":1,"totalLines":85}}}

Returns 'unknown' if the package is\n * not resolvable (e.g. in a bundled/stripped deployment).\n */\nfunction readPackageVersion(packageJsonPath: string): string {\n  try {\n    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires\n    return require(packageJsonPath).version;\n  } catch {\n    return 'unknown';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Runtime framework versions exposed by the health endpoint.\n * Used to identify NestJS v10 vs v11 and Express v4 vs v5 during\n * phased upgrade rollouts (ADR-013 Section 8.4).\n */\nexport interface FrameworkVersionInfo {\n  /** NestJS framework version — e.g. \"10.4.15\" or \"11.0.1\" */\n  nestjs: string;\n  /** Express HTTP adapter version — v4 (NestJS v10) vs v5 (NestJS v11) */\n  express: string;\n  /** Node.js runtime version */\n  node: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Standard health check response for the general /health endpoint.\n * Contains only non-sensitive information safe for public exposure.\n */\nexport interface StandardHealthResponse {\n  status: 'ok';\n  timestamp: string;\n  uptime: number;\n  version: string;\n  /** Service name for identification in multi-service monitoring */\n  service: string;\n  /** Framework versions for v10/v11 identification during phased upgrade */\n  framework: FrameworkVersionInfo;\n}\n\n/**\n * Readiness check response for the /health/ready endpoint.\n * Reports service readiness and dependency checks.\n */\nexport interface ReadinessResponse {\n  status: 'ok' | 'degraded' | 'not_ready';\n  checks: {\n    database: 'ok' | 'error';\n    [key: string]: 'ok' | 'error';\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Configuration options for the StandardHealthController.\n * Services can extend this controller and provide service-specific options.\n */\nexport interface HealthControllerOptions {\n  /**\n   * Service name for logging purposes.\n   */\n  serviceName: string;\n\n  /**\n   * Service version. Defaults to process.env.APP_VERSION or '0.0.0'.\n   */\n  version?: string;\n\n  /**\n   * Additional readiness checks beyond the standard database check.\n   * Each check returns 'ok' or 'error'.\n   */\n  additionalChecks?: () => Promise<Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'>>;\n}\n\n/**\n * StandardHealthController\n *\n * Provides a unified health check format across all microservices for K8s probes:\n *\n *   GET /health/live  -> Liveness probe. Always returns 200 if process is alive.\n *   GET /health/ready -> Readiness probe. Returns 200 if database (and custom checks)\n *                        are reachable, 503 otherwise.\n *   GET /health       -> General health. Returns sanitized status with timestamp,\n *                        uptime, and version. No sensitive data.\n *\n * All endpoints are public (no auth/tenant required) and skip throttling so that\n * K8s probes and load balancers always get a response.\n *\n * Services can extend this controller to add service-specific checks (e.g. TimescaleDB,\n * NATS, MQTT) by overriding `getAdditionalChecks()`.\n */\n@Controller('health')\n@Public()\n@SkipThrottle()\nexport class StandardHealthController {\n  protected serviceName = 'service';\n  protected version: string = process.env['APP_VERSION'] || '0.0.0';\n\n  private _logger?: Logger;\n\n  /** Lazily creates a Logger using the (possibly overridden) serviceName. */\n  protected get logger(): Logger {\n    if (!this._logger) {\n      this._logger = new Logger(`${this.serviceName}:HealthController`);\n    }\n    return this._logger;\n  }\n\n  /** Allow subclasses to replace the logger. */\n  protected set logger(value: Logger) {\n    this._logger = value;\n  }\n\n  constructor(\n    @InjectDataSource()\n    protected readonly dataSource: DataSource,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * K8s Liveness Probe.\n   * Returns 200 as long as the process is running.\n   * K8s restarts the pod if this fails.\n   */\n  @Get('live')\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  liveness(): { status: 'ok' } {\n    return { status: 'ok' };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * K8s Readiness Probe.\n   * Returns 200 if the database is reachable (via `SELECT 1`).\n   * Returns 503 if the database is unreachable.\n   * K8s removes the pod from service endpoints if this fails.\n   */\n  @Get('ready')\n  async readiness(@Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {\n    const checks: Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'> = {\n      database: await this.checkDatabase(),\n    };\n\n    // Merge additional checks from subclasses\n    const extra = await this.getAdditionalChecks();\n    Object.assign(checks, extra);\n\n    const hasError = Object.values(checks).some((v) => v === 'error');\n    const allError = Object.values(checks).every((v) => v === 'error');\n\n    let status: ReadinessResponse['status'];\n    if (allError) {\n      status = 'not_ready';\n    } else if (hasError) {\n      status = 'degraded';\n    } else {\n      status = 'ok';\n    }\n\n    const httpStatus =\n      status === 'not_ready'\n        ? HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE\n        : HttpStatus.OK;\n\n    const body: ReadinessResponse = { status, checks: checks as ReadinessResponse['checks'] };\n    res.status(httpStatus).json(body);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * General Health Endpoint.\n   * Returns sanitized health information (no memory, connection counts, etc.).\n   * Safe for public exposure.\n   *\n   * ADR-013 Section 8.4: Includes framework version info so operators can\n   * identify whether a running service is NestJS v10 or v11 during phased\n   * upgrade rollouts. The `framework` block exposes NestJS core version,\n   * Express adapter version, and Node.js runtime version.\n   */\n  @Get()\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  health(): StandardHealthResponse {\n    return {\n      status: 'ok',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      uptime: process.uptime(),\n      version: this.version,\n      service: this.serviceName,\n      framework: {\n        nestjs: readPackageVersion('@nestjs/core/package.json'),\n        express: readPackageVersion('express/package.json'),\n        node: process.version,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check database connectivity using a real query.\n   * Subclasses should NOT override this; use getAdditionalChecks() instead.\n   */\n  protected async checkDatabase(): Promise<'ok' | 'error'> {\n    try {\n      if (!this.dataSource.isInitialized) {\n        return 'error';\n      }\n      await this.dataSource.query('SELECT 1');\n      return 'ok';\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Database health check failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n      );\n      return 'error';\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Override in subclasses to add service-specific readiness checks.\n   * Return a map of check-name -> 'ok' | 'error'.\n   *\n   * @example\n   * // In SensorHealthController:\n   * protected async getAdditionalChecks() {\n   *   return { timescale: await this.checkTimescale() };\n   * }\n   */\n  protected async getAdditionalChecks(): Promise<Record<string, 'ok' | 'error'>> {\n    return {};\n  }\n}\n","numLines":246,"startLine":1,"totalLines":246}}}

* StandardHealthController Unit Tests\n *\n * Validates the standardized health check format used across all microservices:\n *   GET /health/live  -> { status: 'ok' }                           (always 200)\n *   GET /health/ready -> { status, checks: { database } }           (200 or 503)\n *   GET /health       -> { status, timestamp, uptime, version }     (always 200)\n */\n\nimport { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';\nimport { DataSource } from 'typeorm';\nimport { Controller } from '@nestjs/common';\n\nimport { StandardHealthController } from '../standard-health.controller';\n\n// Mock response object for @Res() endpoints\nconst createMockResponse = () => {\n  const res: any = {\n    status: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),\n    json: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),\n  };\n  return res;\n};\n\ndescribe('StandardHealthController', () => {\n  let controller: StandardHealthController;\n  let queryMock: jest.Mock;\n  let isInitialized: boolean;\n\n  const createMockDataSource = () => ({\n    get isInitialized() {\n      return isInitialized;\n    },\n    query: queryMock,\n  });\n\n  beforeEach(async () => {\n    isInitialized = true;\n    queryMock = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([{ '?column?': 1 }]);\n\n    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({\n      controllers: [StandardHealthController],\n      providers: [\n        {\n          provide: DataSource,\n          useFactory: createMockDataSource,\n        },\n      ],\n    }).compile();\n\n    controller = module.get<StandardHealthController>(StandardHealthController);\n  });\n\n  describe('GET /health/live (liveness)', () => {\n    it('should return { status: \"ok\" }', () => {\n      const result = controller.liveness();\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'ok' });\n    });\n\n    it('should always succeed regardless of database state', () => {\n      isInitialized = false;\n      const result = controller.liveness();\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'ok' });\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('GET /health/ready (readiness)', () => {\n    it('should return 200 with database ok when DB is healthy', async () => {\n      const res = createMockResponse();\n      queryMock.mockResolvedValue([{ '?column?': 1 }]);\n\n      await controller.readiness(res);\n\n      expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(200);\n      expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n        status: 'ok',\n        checks: { database: 'ok' },\n      });\n    });\n\n    it('should return 503 when database is not initialized', async () => {\n      isInitialized = false;\n      const res = createMockResponse();\n\n      await controller.readiness(res);\n\n      expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(503);\n      expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n        status: 'not_ready',\n        checks: { database: 'error' },\n      });\n    });\n\n    it('should return 503 when database query fails', async () => {\n      queryMock.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Connection refused'));\n      const res = createMockResponse();\n\n      await controller.readiness(res);\n\n      expect(res.status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(503);\n      expect(res.json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n        status: 'not_ready',\n        checks: { database: 'error' },\n      });\n    });\n\n    it('should use real SELECT 1 query, not just isInitialized', async () => {\n      const res = createMockResponse();\n      await controller.readiness(res);\n\n      expect(queryMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('SELECT 1');\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('GET /health (general health)', () => {\n    it('should return standardized health response', () => {\n      const result = controller.health();\n\n      expect(result.status).toBe('ok');\n      expect(result.timestamp).toBeDefined();\n      expect(typeof result.uptime).toBe('number');\n      expect(result.uptime).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);\n      expect(result.version).toBeDefined();\n    });\n\n    it('should include valid ISO timestamp', () => {\n      const result = controller.health();\n      const timestamp = new Date(result.timestamp);\n      expect(timestamp.toISOString()).toBe(result.timestamp);\n    });\n\n    it('should report actual process uptime', () => {\n      const beforeUptime = process.uptime();\n      const result = controller.health();\n      const afterUptime = process.uptime();\n\n      expect(result.uptime).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(beforeUptime);\n      expect(result.uptime).toBeLessThanOrEqual(afterUptime);\n    });\n\n    it('should not expose sensitive data', () => {\n      const result = controller.health() as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;\n      expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('database');\n      expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('memory');\n      expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('connections');\n    });\n\n    it('should include service name (ADR-013 Section 8.4)', () => {\n      const result = controller.health();\n      expect(result.service).toBeDefined();","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":251}}}
